{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:Carbon_crystal.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Carbon crystals on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]]]
{{Quote|Carbon is used to create duraplast, which we use for building.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
'''Carbon''' ('''C''')<ref name="Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref><ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref> was a nonmetallic element. It was the primary element in most of the sentient life of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] races. Carbon was used in the manufacture of such substances as [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]], [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], and [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]]. It could be found in naturally occurring crystal form as [[Diamond/Legends|diamonds]]. It was also found in wood and [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]].

Carbon atoms bonded with many other elements, and were able to form long molecular chains and rings, the backbones of organic molecules. The only possible rival for the role of carbon in biology was [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]], which shared some of the same properties of carbon. However, silicon could only bond with two other atoms, whereas carbon could bond with up to four other atoms at once. Therefore, most lifeforms in the galaxy were carbon-based, while silicon-based lifeforms were extremely rare,<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> one example being the crystalline [[Tsil]] of [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. According to a droid, all sentient carbon-based lifeforms could drink [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

In order to manufacture building-grade duraplast, carbon had to be extracted using [[Droid/Legends|droid]] or organic workers, mostly from trees, such as [[oak tree]]s or [[barren tree]]s, and other local resources, including carbon rocks. The mined carbon could then be dropped off for processing at [[command center]]s and [[carbon processing center]]s.<ref name="SW:GB" /> This could be accomplished by logging and extracting carbon from timber, or by mining [[Coal/Legends|coal]] or carbon-heavy rocks.

Carbon residue or scoring was left behind when an object was struck by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster bolt]].

==Behind the scenes==
Carbon was used as a bountiful resource for creating troops and vehicles in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] expansion pack [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']].
